method: Fresh subagent with no conversation context; it read the installed Skill (SKILL.md, dedupe.md, answer-policy.md) and label-free inputs (pairs without labels, questions without rubrics). Gold files were not readable to it by instruction.
caveats: The gold labels were written by the same author session that wrote the Skill, so they encode the Skill's own reading of MERGE/RELATED/DISTINCT.
The subagent was asked for MERGE/RELATED/DISTINCT; dedupe.md uses five actions, mapped by the subagent.
Answers: dev.mysql.com returned 403, so MySQL cases cite Oracle's official mirror docs.oracle.com; the automatic reference-domain check fails for a03/a04 only for that reason.
answer_scores.jsonl was written by a separate fresh Opus subagent acting as judge (did not write the answers); every quote was also checked verbatim against the saved page text (96/96).
